description: Add or change a line in the price list. Required: key, name, and a price: unit_price in MAIN units (450 = 450.00 — NOT cents), or unit_price_minor in cents/rappen, or price_chf ('450' / "1'234.56"). Optional: description, unit (default 'Stk'), vat_rate (default: the seller country's standard rate), is_standard (proposed on every new quote), active, sort. An existing key is updated, not duplicated.

is_standard.description: true proposes this line on every new quote

key.description: Unique key of the price list line; an existing key is updated

price_chf.description: Price as text in main units, e.g. '450' or "1'234.56"

name: upsert_offer_item
